name: Orca ADE (w/ Relay)
description: Orca agent server + your own relay: Claude Code, Codex, Pi from any device
$note: Sibling of template.json (Orca ADE, one service). Same orca image; ORCA_PASSWORD switches it into control mode. Build/verify scripts: build_relay_source.py, relay_repair.py.

why_two_services.$note: orca serve never starts Orca's relay client (only desktop mode does: src/main/startup/main-process-runtime-launch.ts launchDesktopMode), and the browser web client stubs out pairing/relay/cloud sign-in (src/renderer/src/web/preload-api/web-mobile-api.ts, web-orca-profiles-api.ts). So the Railway server is reached directly over its public wss:// endpoint and cannot itself use a relay. The relay serves Orca desktop apps on the deployer's own computers, so their phones reach those computers from anywhere. Both share one password.

orca.mode: control (ORCA_PASSWORD set): control/control.mjs owns $PORT=8080, runs `orca serve --json` on loopback 6768, proxies HTTP+WS to it, serves /control
orca.healthcheckNote: 503 until orca serve printed its ready JSON, so the deploy only goes green once Orca is really up. No hyphen in the path (Railway rejects hyphenated healthcheck paths).

variables.GH_TOKEN: optional prompt; gh reads it natively, orca-boot runs gh auth setup-git so git push works too

control_page.$note: Pairing offers are minted only at orca serve startup (no RPC). Rotate/revoke therefore stop Orca, edit ~/.config/orca/orca-devices.json (lowercase 'orca', verified), and restart; the ready JSON is captured from stdout and never logged. Terminals are daemon-backed, so agents survive the restart (to verify live).

relay.mode: relay/front.mjs owns $PORT=8080: /admin, /v1/desktop/auth/* (sign-in shim), /.well-known/jwks.json; everything else proxied to upstream's relay (combined role, SQLite) on loopback 8081, which it supervises
relay.volume: /data (relay/ sqlite, auth/ signing key, assignment key, hosts.json)

variables.ORCA_PASSWORD: required prompt, no default: the deployer must know it to use /control and /admin and to sign computers in

relay.keys: Signing key (ES256) and assignment key are generated on first boot onto the volume, not template variables, so nothing secret is in the template config. Rotating the signing key from /admin signs every computer out.

not_possible_upstream: Relay pairing from the web UI (stubbed out in the browser build).
Start/stop multiple relays: one relay serves unlimited computers; there is nothing to gain.
Rotating a relay 'pairing code': relay invites are minted by each Orca desktop, not by the relay.
